items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah. I got them all. They all became members of my group.

ctx.x: But you heard them playing, and they had the feeling.

Yeah. I got them all. They all became members of my group. Not – they didn’t just stay in Norway. They moved to Stockholm and did things in Stockholm. When I’d go to Italy or something, they’d go. Finally, they were signed over to a company that only specialized in jazz.
ECM Records. Manfred Eichner or something.
